properties.title: CalCOFI Sonobuoy Baleen Whale Call Detections — v2026.10.06
properties.description: Hourly presence of blue, fin and humpback whale calls in sonobuoy recordings from CalCOFI cruises, 2004-2012. Each record is one hour of a DIFAR or omnidirectional sonobuoy deployment near a CalCOFI station, scanned by an analyst as 60-second spectrogram windows, with the call types heard. Curated by the Scripps Whale Acoustics Lab (Baumann-Pickering) and staged from the CalCOFI marine mammal Shiny app repository (CalCOFI/marmam-app). The hydrophone depth is not recorded (the DIFAR or omnidirectional setting is not given), so sample and observation depths are empty, not 0 m. Hours scanned only for a few calls ("adhoc only") are kept as samples with no presence value.

table:columns.name: obs_id
table:columns.description: Surrogate key, renumbered globally when the release concatenates the per-dataset shards.

table:columns.name: realm
table:columns.description: `env` for physical/chemical measurements, `bio` for organism observations.

table:columns.name: dataset_key
table:columns.description: Provenance stamp: `provider_dataset`.

table:columns.name: sample_key
table:columns.description: The sampling event this observation came from; joins `sample`.

table:columns.name: grid_key
table:columns.description: CalCOFI station grid cell, denormalized from `sample` so rollups need no join. NULL for region-pooled data.

table:columns.name: cruise_key
table:columns.description: Cruise, denormalized from `sample` so rollups need no join.

table:columns.name: latitude
table:columns.description: Observation latitude (WGS84).

table:columns.name: longitude
table:columns.description: Observation longitude (WGS84).

table:columns.name: datetime
table:columns.description: Observation time (UTC). NULL for region-pooled data with no event time.

table:columns.name: depth_min_m
table:columns.description: Shallowest depth this observation represents.

table:columns.name: depth_max_m
table:columns.description: Deepest depth this observation represents; equal to `depth_min_m` for point measurements (bottle, CTD scan).

table:columns.name: taxon_key
table:columns.description: Global taxon key, `worms:<AphiaID>` or `itis:<TSN>` for birds. NULL for `env` rows. Joins `taxon`.

table:columns.name: life_stage
table:columns.description: Life stage where the source resolves one (larva, adult, juvenile, egg, phyllosoma).

table:columns.name: measurement_type
table:columns.description: Measured quantity; joins the `measurement_type` vocabulary.

table:columns.name: measurement_value
table:columns.description: The measured value, in the units `measurement_type` declares.

table:columns.name: measurement_qual
table:columns.description: Source quality flag, verbatim.

table:columns.name: measurement_prec
table:columns.description: Source-reported precision where available.

table:columns.name: hex_id
table:columns.description: H3 cell at resolution 10, stored as UBIGINT. Aggregate coarser at query time with `h3_cell_to_parent(hex_id, res)` — there is no per-resolution column ladder.

table:columns.name: taxon_group_key
table:columns.description: Group key, `<dataset-or-known-list>:<group>`.

table:columns.name: description
table:columns.description: Human-readable description of the group.

table:columns.name: taxon_key
table:columns.description: A member taxon; joins `taxon`.
